title: sh-ui
tagline: Short name, solid fundamentals — a multi-platform design system designed for clarity. Black & white by default, forged to your config and copied straight into your project.

philosophy.ownership: You own the code — sources are copied into your project rather than bundled as a package (shadcn-style).
philosophy.tokens: One token, many platforms — the same semantic tokens generate CSS variables for React and Dart constants for Flutter from a single source.
philosophy.config: Config-driven transforms — sh-ui.config.json theme/radius values are baked into tokens at copy time.
